g.text: 1. Power Routing: 5V inputs (UART 5V, USB 5V, or 12V-to-5V Buck Converter) are stepped down to 3.3V via LDO.

g.desc: 1. Power Routing: 5V inputs (UART 5V, USB 5V, or 12V-to-5V Buck Converter) are stepped down to 3.3V via LDO.

g.text: 2. Power Ratings: Buck Converter = 600mA max / LDO = 300mA max.

g.desc: 2. Power Ratings: Buck Converter = 600mA max / LDO = 300mA max.

g.text: 3. Power Budget: System is designed for a 150mA max current consumption.

g.desc: 3. Power Budget: System is designed for a 150mA max current consumption.

g.text: (Actual typical load for MCU and peripherals is approx. 75mA, providing a 2x safety margin).
